title: Toronto Sold 60 New Condos in 3 Months: What Happened to the Presale Market
seoTitle: Toronto Sold 60 New Condos in 3 Months: What Happened
description: From almost 31,000 new condo sales in 2021 to 60 in a single quarter. Why Toronto presale demand collapsed and why it could lead to a housing shortage.
answer: Toronto presale condo sales collapsed because the buyers who drove them were mostly investors. When interest rates rose and rents no longer covered mortgages, about 70% of investors with a new condo mortgage were losing money every month, so they stopped buying. Sales fell from almost 31,000 in 2021 to about 1,500 in 2025, and 60 in three months of summer 2026.
body:
Same city. Same skyline. Same cranes. Yet the Toronto region went from almost 31,000 new condo sales in 2021 to about 1,500 last year, a drop of 95%. This summer it sold 60 pre-construction units in three months. Here is what disappeared.

## The numbers behind the collapse

- **2021:** almost 31,000 new condos sold in the region.
- **2025:** about 1,500, the lowest level since 1991.
- **Summer 2026:** 60 presale units in three months.
- **Today:** investment groups are buying finished, unsold units for about 40% less than the original price in the same buildings.

## Why the buyers stopped

The Toronto presale market was built on investors. According to a study by Urbanation and CIBC, they were 70% or more of presale buyers. They bought for appreciation, not to live in the units. When interest rates went up, rents could no longer pay the mortgage. The same study found that about 70% of investors with a mortgage on a new condo were losing money every month. Once that happened, there was no reason to keep buying.

## The money did not leave, the believers did

The capital is still in the city. What left was the belief that a unit bought today would be worth more tomorrow. Off-plan only works while enough buyers hold that belief.

## Why this matters even if you never bought a presale

It is tempting to feel the over-leveraged investor got what was coming. But when buyers leave, construction leaves too. The number of condos under construction around Toronto is now at its lowest level since early 2012, and analysts warn of a serious shortage by the end of the decade. Fewer projects today means fewer homes for everyone later.

These figures are as reported in 2026. This is information, not financial advice.

The full episode explains who creates off-plan believers and five signs a storm is coming. Listen at [/podcast/off-plan-runs-on-believers-here-is-how-it-breaks/](/podcast/off-plan-runs-on-believers-here-is-how-it-breaks/).
takeaways: Toronto new condo sales fell about 95% between 2021 and 2025.
Investors were 70% or more of presale buyers, so their exit emptied the market.
About 70% of investors with a new condo mortgage were losing money every month.
Construction starts fell with sales, which analysts say could cause a shortage later this decade.
faq: How many new condos sold in Toronto in 2025?
About 1,500 new condos sold in the Toronto region in 2025, roughly 95% fewer than in 2021 and the lowest level since 1991.
Why are Toronto condo investors losing money?
Higher interest rates pushed mortgage payments above what the units earn in rent. A study by Urbanation and CIBC found about 70% of investors with a new condo mortgage were losing money every month.
Will Toronto have a housing shortage?
Analysts warn it could. Condos under construction are at the lowest level since early 2012, so fewer new homes will be finished later in the decade.
